title: Scheduling with Teams DEUS
summary: In an AI chat connected to the Teams DEUS connector, suggest follow-ups and dates, then create the tasks and calendar events.

steps.title: Suggest follow-ups and dates
steps.goal: Each follow-up with an owner, a proposed date and the reason for it, plus a pushback when a date or timeline looks unrealistic
steps.note: No benchmark tests date maths or time zones. Give the model today's date, and check each date (Asia/Jakarta days, working-day gaps) in the preview.

steps.title: Create the tasks
steps.goal: Run the connector's steps in order (category, company, main task, each step, free times, preview, save) without inventing dates, times or free slots
steps.other_checks: Whether the model follows the connector's one-question-per-step rule only shows in real use.
steps.note: AutomationBench-AA is the closest match: agentic workflows in business apps. Read every preview warning before confirming the save.
